items.title: NIKE (NKE) Could Be 6% Undervalued On Analyst Downgrades And Reset Risks
items.summary: NIKE (NKE) is back in focus after a series of analyst downgrades linked to excess Jordan inventory, pressure in China, and a multi-year cost-cutting overhaul that is keeping near-term earnings under strain. At a share price of US$38.59, NIKE has seen a 12.31% 1 month share price return even as analyst downgrades and restructuring headlines dominate.
